title: OKX invite code: what it is and how to use it

scenes.title: OKX invite code
scenes.sub: Same field as a referral code

lines.show: An OKX invite code is the code an existing user shares so a new user can link their account at sign-up.
In everyday use, invite code and referral code mean the same thing.
They go into the same field when you create your account.
Open the official OKX app and tap Sign up.
Look for the invite or referral code line, which may be marked optional.
Type the code before you finish.

scenes.title: Skip paid VIP invites
scenes.text: No one needs to sell you a code.

lines.show: Some posts sell VIP invite codes. Skip them. VIP tiers follow OKX's own fee rules.
The invite code for this video is XOACPQFC.

scenes.title: If OKX is available where you live

lines.show: If OKX is available where you live, enter XOACPQFC in the invite field at sign-up.
